title: contextual incident briefs and auto-checklist generator for on-call
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: On-call responders repeatedly ask for a concise, actionable summary at incident start (what changed, likely blast radius, probable remediation steps). This PR adds an incident-brief generator plus an auto-checklist feature that synthesizes telemetry, recent deploys, and runbook fragments into a 1-3 bullet brief and a prioritized checklist.

What this does (high level):
- Adds a lightweight briefing service that consumes alert metadata, recent traces, and deployment notes to produce a short incident brief and a suggested checklist.
- Integrates with incident-bot to post a brief into the incident channel and attach a checklist that can be ticked off during triage.
- Provides an operator-facing preview UI in the SLO Toolkit console to review and edit the generated brief before posting.

Checklist for reviewers:
- [ ] validate telemetry parsers for alerts and traces
- [ ] confirm no PII leaks in brief generation
- [ ] run the oncall e2e harness locally and in CI
- [ ] sanity check suggestion ordering heuristics

Implementation notes:
- Briefing service is implemented in Go under internal/briefing for low-latency extraction; heavy heuristic scoring runs in a separate worker using Python to reuse existing NLP helpers.
- Uses existing policy tags from alert metadata to prioritize checklist items (e.g., database, auth, network).
- Includes simple rate limiting and backoff to avoid noisy-post loops when alerts flood.

Rollout plan:
1) Feature behind flag (slo.briefing.enabled) on staging for 48h and sampling at 10% on prod.
2) Monitor posting rate, average brief length, and oncall feedback metric (emoji reaction) for two weeks.
3) Increase sampling to 50% then global enable if no regressions.

Testing:
- Unit tests for parser, scoring, and checklist generation included.
- Added e2e scenarios that simulate deploy-caused incidents and noise floods.

Security and compliance:
- Brief generator redacts potential secret patterns and strips long stack traces by default.
- No new IAM surfaces; service runs under existing slo-toolkit service account.

Docs:
- Adds a console doc page with screenshots and config knobs, plus an operations runbook for when the briefing service fails to generate summaries.

Notes:
- This is intentionally conservative: the first iteration focuses on high precision (don't suggest noisy or incorrect checklist items) over recall. Future work will add feedback loops to improve suggestions.

References: Linear ENG-4021, SUP-1123, past postmortem INT-2025-DB-failures.
